items.title: 3 Founder Led Stocks With Revenue Growth Up To 26%
items.summary: Fresh tariffs from the Trump administration are shaking up global supply chains again, which puts a spotlight on companies where the founder still has skin in the game and a personal legacy to protect. Leaders who built the business from scratch often react faster when trade rules change or costs suddenly shift. This article highlights three founder driven stocks that show how that mindset can matter for long term investors. The three stocks highlighted here offer a compelling starting point...

items.title: Workday earnings analysis: questions answered and next catalysts
items.summary: Investing.com -- Workday Inc (WDAY) beat on the FY2027 Q3 report (Nov 24, 2026), then slid about 8.6% after hours to $163.76. By 3:09 PM EST on Nov 25 it had recovered to $182.33 (+1.73%), with a market cap of about $43.46B. The intraday low was $173.00. The stock is still down 13.05% over the past month and 14.99% YTD.
